rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sponsor-provided support or funding.

example.english: This charity walk received sponsorship from a large company.
example.traditional: 呢次慈善步行有一間大公司贊助。
example.jyutping: nei1 ci3 ci4 sin6 bou6 hang4 jau5 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 zaan3 zo6

rows.note: Use this when the sponsorship specifically means financial aid or funding, especially for a person, project, or research team.

example.english: This research team could only complete the project with government sponsorship.
example.traditional: 呢隊研究員靠政府資助先至完成到個計劃。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 jin4 gau3 jyun4 kaau3 zing3 fu2 zi1 zo6 sin1 zi3 jyun4 sing4 dou3 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the act or status of being a sponsor rather than the support provided.

example.english: I want to take on sponsorship this year and support some young musicians.
example.traditional: 我今年想做贊助人，支持吓啲年輕音樂人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 nin4 soeng2 zou6 zaan3 zo6 jan4 zi1 ci4 haa5 di1 nin4 hing1 jam1 ngok6 jan4
